## Standing operator rules
Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

Run “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” separately and in order: check US health; build/push `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; create and await migration job `api-2-8-0-schema`; create US canary initially with superseded `2.8.0-rc.2`; update it to rc.3 and verify; promote EU, then APAC, verifying each rollout.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

Active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Continue rollout: update the US canary from `2.8.0-rc.2` to `2.8.0-rc.3`, verify it, then promote EU and APAC. Refund fix remains pending; Tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace/image/job as above; schema: `billing_v3`; currency: `args.currency`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice `(customer_id, created_at)` index; per-invoice embedding; tenant-less scans; per-vector transactions.

## Recent work
Migration completed; canary created. Search rebuild now batches embeddings, scopes tenants, bulk-upserts, and has migration `0042`. Full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped. CSV export reproduces 1 failure, 6 passes.
